notes.title: fine🙄, you can play by yourself
notes.content:
Let's see, what was added?

- You can now play Tricky Typing [b]all by yourself![/b] I heard a lot of y'all [i]don't [/i]have friends? 🤷🏿‍♀️ That's none of my business, but I have included a Single Player Mode in Tricky Typing. You can now type to your singular heart's content

- ☁Cloud Saves☁ will keep your stats saved across devices
- The Main Menu has been updated to look 12%🤏 more appealing
- Practice Mode now allows you to practice real words
- Playstation Controller support is even better
- The Tutorial has been updated
- A 'Pause Reminder' was added to the bottom of each match, just in case you forgot
- New accessibility options were added:
[list]
[*]Disable Streaks
[*]Disable Screen Shake
[*]Disable Vibration
[*]Disable Pause Reminder
[*]Change Game Speed (50% - 150%)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42145921/4895cc62f6ea9aa5f06793bc168d90e1ec25d9b0.png[/img]

- 2 new Power Ups were added:
• Multiplier: Each word you finish will now count as DOUBLE POINTS
• Goblin: This STANKY guy will steal 20% of the highest player's points
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42145921/0e218d0c72471c95a1da2013c47adc73ee59724d.png[/img]

Go on, play it right now

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1453160/Tricky_Typing/

notes.title: Small Dictionary Update
notes.content:
Hey guys, I've received some feedback and am glad to let y'all know that when adding words in the Dictionary, the letters will now highlight, just like when practicing. I hope this update makes it not so [i]Tricky[/i] to add your own words so y'all can get back to [i]Typing[/i]
